subject: Liz Mullane City Council Candidacy
overview: City Council candidate Liz Mullane discussed her professional background in nonprofit management and her platform priorities for Medford. The interview focused on fiscal oversight, infrastructure improvements, and her affiliation with the Our Revolution organization.

items.title: Candidate introduction and background
items.summary: Liz Mullane introduced herself as a nonprofit advancement professional and adjunct faculty member who has lived in Medford since 2018.

items.title: Motivation for running
items.summary: Mullane cited concerns over pedestrian safety on the Fells Way and the condition of city roads as primary reasons for entering the race.

items.title: Professional experience and fiscal priorities
items.summary: The candidate described how her background in fundraising, grant writing, and nonprofit budgeting could help identify new revenue streams for city services like the library and mental health programs.

items.title: Policy platform and community goals
items.summary: Platform priorities include conducting a citywide pedestrian safety audit, expanding green space, supporting the Affordable Housing Trust, and streamlining processes for small businesses.

items.title: Our Revolution affiliation and representation
items.summary: Mullane addressed her endorsement by Our Revolution, stating she aims to use her negotiation experience to represent all constituents while advocating for progressive environmental and educational policies.

items.title: Campaign contact information
items.summary: The candidate provided her website and social media handles for voters to seek more information or get in touch with the campaign.
